terminals.name: api-server
terminals.description: TypeScript API server (@workspace/api-server) on http://localhost:8080. Health: GET /api/healthz. Needs Postgres (provisioned by start.sh). Not a watcher — restart to pick up source changes.

terminals.name: nyxus-web
terminals.description: Primary Vite web app (@workspace/nyxus-web) on http://localhost:18304. Other web surfaces: pnpm --filter @workspace/<app> run dev (nyxus-notepad, nyxus-stickies, nyxus-sysmon, nyxus-widgets, mockup-sandbox).
